Vigraha
by Viṣṇuśarman. a sn. of Hitopadeśa. See under Hitopadeśa.

Vigraha
name of C. by Haripaṇḍita on Amarakośa of Amarasiṃha.
Pt.. Poona, 1881. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92, 10. 128.

Vigrahakośa
by Gopālaśāstrin Ghaṇṭe.
Pt.. in Bapuhara Shveta Devalekara Press, Bombay, 1867.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 114; also IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 2984.

Vigrahaṃ_Deśikācārya
or Deśikācārya of Vaṅgīśa family, authority on Viśiṣṭādvaita.
-Aṇṇayāryamaṅgalam. VORI. Tirupati 76.
-Arthasamājagrastatvavicāra. ny. VORI. Tirupati 433.
-Asti brahmeti śrutyarthavicāra.

-Nārāyaṇabalividhikhaṇḍana. VORI. Tirupati 3002.

Vigrahadhyāna
viś. adv. by Nainārācārya or Kumāravaradācārya, son of Vedāntadeśika. Adyar II. p. 165b. Oppert

Vigrahapratiṣṭhāvidhi
Adyar II. p. 191a. Jaipur Mus.

Vigraharājadeva
of Viśāladeva. King of Śākambarī (1153 A. D.).
-Harakelināṭaka or Lalitavigraharāja. A portion of it mentioned in a. inscr. a. Ajmer. But Harakelināṭaka was composed by Somadeva in honour of Vigraharājadeva an. attr. to him.
For more ref. see Lalitavigraharāja.

Vigraharāja_Bhaṭṭa
-C. on Sāṅkhyasaptatikā or Sāṅkhyakārikā of Īśvarakṛṣṇa.
-A. IIO. Stein 293. SB. New D.. VII. ii. 93725.

Vigrahavyāvartanīkārikā
